title: Great day on the water!
text: We had a great time on our sailing tour!  lots of food and drinks while sailing in the harbor checking out all the huge yachts!
author: Laura_W

title: Vacation
text: Edu was absolutely incredible! Thank you for one of the best experiences we had in Spain!
author: davidaQ8717LT

title: Great trip with amazing views
text:
We had an amazing sailing experience! With skipper Marie we were very well taken care off, and we even got to help a bit on the boat which made for an even better experience! The organisation is very professional and provides an overall smooth experience from A-Z 

I would definitely go here again
author: Wanderer672456

title: Relaxing
text: Very relaxing. We had a beautiful day with Captain Carlos.   Very nice sailing along the coast. May I suggest you sail the day after you have taken a long tour. Your body, mind will thank you.
author: dreed560

title: Sail boat excursion
text: Had a wonderful time. Our driver Carlos was a joy to be around and very informative.
author: bertabobw

title: Great experience.
text: It was a great sail. Good to see Barcelona from the water. Very relaxing and cooler than in town. Drinks and snacks were great. I would do this again. Our captain was experienced and fun. Thanks Mikel.
author: S3072DPjohnh

title: Great value relaxing boat ride!
text: Great value relaxing boat ride, Carlos was excellent, helpful and informative acting as a tour guide too, you get maximum sailing time and they time it well, would recommend
